lines.text: Arcana comes over to the door.
It's not going to work. I think it's jammed or...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're right... What do we do?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's gym class, so I didn't either.
I glance at the storage room door.
It looks pretty sturdy, but maybe if we ram it...
Do you think you could break this down?
Arcana shows me her pale and slender arm.
As I look at it, I remember the athleticism, or terrible lack thereof, that she displayed earlier in class...
If nothing else works, I'll try breaking it.
For now, though, we should probably shout for...
Arcana gently grabs my wrist as I'm about to bang on the metal door.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hold on, this is a rare opportunity.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Usually, we're Nikke and Commander, but not now...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... we find ourselves in a classic setup.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The girl who secretly likes her teacher helps him clean up, then they accidentally get locked inside a room together...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Far off, you hear the voices of other students,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: but amid all the noise and bustle, the two protagonists find themselves completely alone, unbeknownst to anyone else.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then, in such a confined space,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: something suddenly falls over, or comes crashing down,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and I get all started and lose my balance, and you reach out to catch me and...
Startled, Arcana loses her balance. I open my arms and hold her as we fall onto the mat.
We look and see a box filled with different sports balls on the ground, having fallen from its shelf.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. It's just like earlier, isn't it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well, maybe not exactly the same.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This time, it's just the two of us... which means no one will get in our way.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Do you want to pick up from where we left off?
Here? Like this? I don't know...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What's wrong? Do you prefer it when other people can see us?
You know that's not what I meant...
Arcana quietly takes a deep breath and looks up at me, her eyes slightly shining.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I were to close my eyes right now,
I slowly lower my head and press my lips to Arcana's.
Her grip on my clothing tightens.
We stay like that for a while.
Then, as if on cue, we both part our lips at the same time.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm feeling a lot... happier than I expected.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I wasn't planning on taking things this far.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I thought we'd flirt a little since we were alone, then leave.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But once the ball started rolling...
Same with me. I couldn't hold back.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then I guess that makes us accomplices.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And, as your partner in crime...
Arcana wraps her arms around my neck.
Arcana whispers sweetly into my ear.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Come on... Don't make me wait.
I pull away from Arcana and stand up.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are we not going to do it?
Arcana sits on the mat and hugs her knees, then looks at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I would've been okay with it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're giving me an awful lot of preferential treatment then, aren't you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It feels like you're claiming me, and letting everyone know that I'm your woman.
Still sitting, Arcana stretches both of her hands toward me.
I take Arcana's hand and pull her up.
Arcana fixes her clothes and walks up to the door.
Arcana shows me a small component that looks like it had been wedged into the gap.
I step in front of Arcana,
That little prank of yours was a step too far.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Tch... You know you liked it too.
I tried to keep my tone stern, but Arcana just looks up at me, completely undeterred.
I look into her clear blue eyes.
Her gaze is as bright and unwavering as always,
filled with deep affection for and trust in me.
At the moment, however, there's also something else mixed in with that...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What? Is there something you want to say?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: By the way, you've got a kitchen in your room, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Want me to make dinner for you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... Good question. I'm guessing you don't have much in terms of ingredients.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's still pretty early for dinner, so how about we go grocery shopping first?
